description: Extracts article content (title, author, published time, markdown content) from NME.com news articles.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - fetch_article: Fetches and extracts article content from an NME.com URL; requires 'url' parameter; 参数: url; 必填: url

url.description: The NME.com article URL to fetch (required for fetch_article function)
